blocks.content: Before relying on your routing setup, verify that notifications are delivered correctly. Grafana lets you send a test notification from any contact point.
To test notification delivery, complete the following steps:
Navigate to **Alerts & IRM > Alerting > Contact points**.

Find the contact point you created and click its **kebab menu** (three dots), then select **Test**.

Grafana sends a test notification through all integrations in the contact point.

Verify the notification arrived at its destination:

| Integration | Where to check |
|-------------|----------------|
| **Email** | Your inbox (check spam/junk) |
| **Slack** | The configured channel |
| **PagerDuty** | PagerDuty incidents |
| **Webhook** | Your endpoint logs |

If the test fails, common fixes include:

- Verify the integration credentials (webhook URL, email address, API key)
- Check that the integration service is reachable from Grafana Cloud
- Review the contact point error banner for details
In the next milestone, you'll review what you've accomplished.
